added.summary: Generates and indexes `ui-tsx` (`@origingame/engine/ui` primitives, hooks, signals, `HostProps`, `UiEvent`), `theme-tokens` (default pack colour roles, theme scales, `packClass` slots, sounds, images, and built-in icons), `playtest` (`@origingame/engine/playtest`), and `provider` (`@origingame/engine/provider`) guides from source in `og api gen`/`og api check`.

Documents `og sfx` and `type sfx` presets (`audio §9`), `type rig2d` 2D auto-rigging templates (`animation §14`), built-in `@canvas/*` and `@palettes/*` look assets (`looks §20`), and theme authoring commands (`themes §6`).

fixed.summary: Composes `og.ui` directly over generated `calls.ui` plus `scope`, memoized `frameViewport`/`frameTheme`, and `formatNumber`, removing the redundant `src/ui-kit/` wrapper layer.
